description: On February 25, 1881, Fanny Mayer followed her brother's call for help in Basel and came to the Feldberg after a painful winter journey. She finds a newborn whose mother has died, and she promises to support her brother until he finds someone to take care of the child and the inn.

title: Im Zug der Zeit oder Wo geht's lang, Genosse Stalin? (2. Teil: Von Moskau in den Krieg)
author: Georgi Dimitroff
description: Georgi Dimitroff is one of the few outstanding communist leaders of the 20th century whose fame, at least in part, has survived to this day in both the East and the West.

title: Außer Briefe schreiben kann man hier nichts
author: Peter Goedel; Herbert Hoven
description: The radio work, which is about the story of the 14-year-old student Markus, is based on an authentic case. Markus is generally considered to be an “unruly boy”. He does not conform to the valid educational norms and insists on his own ways.

title: Trem Pàssaro
author: Denise Garcia
description: The Brazilian composer Denise Garcia, who studied composition for instrumental music in São Paulo with Willy Corrèa de Oliviera and in Detmold and Munich, has been increasingly working with electroacoustic music since the 1990s.

title: Das einzig Sichere ist das Wagnis
author: Sylvia Rauer
description: When Felix Jackson, alias Felix Joachimson, died in California in 1992 at the age of 90, he was one of the few emigrants who made it in the American TV business.

title: Reden in der Dämmerung
author: Volkmar Röhrig; Matthias Thalheim
description: Paul was deployed as a student to defend his hometown in the final days of the Second World War. Several classmates were killed. Now he remembers these events that night.

title: Hilde Duwe, Arbeiterin im VEB Alwo in Brandenburg
author: Peter Goslicki
description: Workers at a textile company agree to work a special shift in support of a solidarity campaign for Vietnam out of gratitude and recognition for their committed colleague Hilde Duwe.

title: Der Vortrag
author: Jana Kursawe
description: In a diary story, a fourteen-year-old student describes her disappointment when she discovers that her father, as a student, was far from being the role model he always presented himself as in his moral sermons.

title: Irene Richter, Schichtmeister im VEB Kunstseidenwerk "Siegfried Rädel" in Pirna
author: Peter Biele; Elifius Paffrath
description: Irene Richter, shift supervisor at the VEB artificial silk factory “Siegfried Rädel” in Pirna, remembers her career from worker to master and the associated requirements.

title: Siegfried Pilling, Meister im Fritz-Heckert-Werk in Karl-Marx-Stadt
author: Siegfried Pfaff
description: Various people describe the exemplary work of Siegfried Pilling, foreman at the Fritz Heckert factory in Karl-Marx-Stadt.

title: Keine Irrfahrt für Odysseus oder Erinnerungen eines gewissen Kautz
author: Hans-Ulrich Lüdemann
description: When the soldier Otto Kautz returns from the Second World War, his wife and their son live with the local teacher. He earns his living collecting food hidden from local farmers, which he commandeers to feed people.

title: Lieselotte Kullmann, Textilarbeiterin im VEB Buntgarnwerke Leipzig-Markleeberg
author: Ulrike Schünemann
description: Employees praise the exemplary work of their colleague Lieselotte Kullmann, textile worker at VEB Buntgarnwerke Leipzig-Markkleeberg.

title: Dero ergebenster Lessing
author: Gotthold Ephraim Lessing
description: Description of Gotthold Ephraim Lessing's years in Wolfenbüttel: his financial hardship, his marriage to Eva König, the death of his wife and child and the constant dispute with the court in letters, writings and other documents.

title: Alles Humbug
author: P. T. Barnum
description: A young wealthy man from the United States accuses the American, manager and everyday guy Barnum of dubious business dealings. Barnum presented Washington's alleged nurse, a mermaid and the "Swedish Nightingale" to the astonished and paying audience.

title: Rudi ist tot
author: Siegfried Hanusch; Birgit Kessler
description: The life of the trade union, SED and economic official (original sound) Rudi Rubbel, who recently died in an accident, is portrayed. His career as an official after the Second World War is illustrated by (original sound) N.

title: Und morgen geht's weiter
author: Siegfried Hanusch
description: Portrait of the foundry engineer, candidate for the SED district leadership and designated party secretary of his company, Horst Trute, born in 1944, from Wernigerode.

title: Damals, als ich heimkam
author: Rolf Wohlgemuth
description: In the first post-war summer, the young, war-wounded Rondell tries to find his way again in the once familiar surroundings of his Erzgebirge homeland, to organize food and to escape the general destruction.

title: Der letzte Penny
author: Manfred Bieler
description: "What will you think about when you die?" The question of the final thought is the question of a life: that of the author. The five characters are at the same time people who determine this life and variations of itself.

title: "Sehr verehrter Heinz Rühmann ..."
author: Heinz Rühmann; N. N.
description: You are the most popular German actor of the last century." The actor's estate contains numerous fan letters that Rühmann kept. They impressively demonstrate how much the audience trusts their star, opens up to him, and even sometimes surrenders to him.

title: Das türkische Rezept oder Leichenschmaus mit Erinnerungen (mit Musikwalzer)
author: Helga M. Novak
description: "The Turkish Recipe" is handwritten by a man who was arrested on the spot in a dark past (1938). Now a pastry chef is on the trail of the remains of the cookbook - until his own sudden death.

title: Tagebuch einer Anpassung
author: Ernst Bruun-Olsen
description: Teacher Graversen decides to keep a diary. What initially looks like a report about his marital crisis and a few women's stories ends up being the story of an opportunist who condemns himself by justifying himself.

title: Das Tagebuch des Benjamin Gniebel
author: Gerhard Niezoldi
description: The author tells the story of the Gniebel family, who led a quiet, harmonious life for years until their son Paul suddenly discovers that his sister Hilde is having a relationship with a married man.

title: Tagebuch einer Liebe oder Jetzt erzählen wir uns eine Geschichte, in der jetzt immerzu jetzt bleibt
author: Alfred Behrens
description: In West Berlin, on the S-Bahn in the morning, they get to know each other, Veronika and Jens; she on the way to the bookstore where she works and he, married, on the way to university.

title: Die Erinnerungen von Ludolf Ursleu dem Jüngeren (1. Teil)
author: Ricarda Huch
description: The important social novel by 28-year-old Ricarda Huch (seven years before Thomas Mann) describes the fate of a Hanseatic patrician family and takes up the theme of love versus reality.

title: Die Erinnerungen von Ludolf Ursleu dem Jüngeren (2. Teil)
author: Ricarda Huch
description: A radio work based on Memories of Ludolf Ursleu the Younger (novel) text adaptation: Barbara Bondy.

title: Sympathetic Streams
author: Marita Loosen
description: "Composers often have a similar problem with sound as some painters have with academic painting: you can also be overtrained. The exciting thing about visual artists' engagement with sound is their naivety towards what they produce." (Terry Fox) The man who says this is one of the unsung stars of the art scene.

title: Die Mimen kommen
author: Camille Schlosser
description: The theater holidays begin and the mimes go to Greece like every year. There they tell each other what the past was like, brag, and are jealous. A fun piece about life “off the stage”.

title: Ediths Tagebuch
author: Patricia Highsmith
description: The story of a marriage and a young woman in America in the second half of the 20th century: Edith Howland moves from New York to the countryside with her husband Brett and son Cliff.

title: ...und Respekt vor zu Erziehenden
author: Günter-Klaus Kellas
description: 06'47 (original sound) Gisela Steineckert (several times) on audience reactions to the original broadcast of her radio work "The Last Page in the Diary" / on raising young people and the generational conflict between parents and young people / on reflecting on her daughter's upbringing / on her dealings with young people / In between, recordings of several…

title: Zum 50. Geburtstag des rheinischen Hörspiels
author: Theo Rausch; Manfred Brückner
description: For the 50th birthday of the Rhenish radio work.

title: Früher - das ist heute noch
author: Klaus Antes
description: During research in the Kalk district of Cologne, a project group from the radio work department happened to meet Ms. B. They approached her after receiving information because she should know the district; after all, she had even lived in the same house for over fifty years.

title: Gerhard Rühm
author: Gerhard Rühm; Klaus Schöning
description: The radio work is based on a piece of a newspaper report, according to which a man is robbed and undressed on a country road one winter night, waiting in vain for help from drivers and ultimately freezing to death.

title: Die Sinnlichkeit der Mikrokosmen
author: Iris Drögekamp
description: He has been keeping an acoustic diary for a long time. The sound composer and former advertising copywriter Asmus Tietchens, born in Hamburg in 1947, has been experimenting with tape recorders, electronic sound generators and concrete sound material since the mid-1960s.

title: "Ich schreibe für mich und Fremde"
author: Mira Alexandra Schnoor
description: “A rose is a rose is a rose” is the most famous sentence by Gertrude Stein (1874-1946), one of the most parodied or quoted sentence structures in literary history.

title: Schürflizenz für ins Grab mitgenommene Geheimnisse
author: Karl Corino
description: Due to the loss of Robert Musil's Viennese estate towards the end of the Second World War, due to the destruction of his library, his family papers, his entire correspondence up to 1938, his archive of photographs and newspaper clippings, due to the dispersal of his exiled friends all over the world, the situation for the biographer was quite...

title: Strahlungen
author: Ernst Jünger
description: The basis of this radio work chamber opera are texts from Ernst Jünger's "Radiations", with a center being the "Paris Diaries". During the German occupation of France, Jünger was a captain in the German headquarters in Paris from February 1941 until the liberation in August 1944.

title: Dschaudars Abenteuer
author: Anonymus
description: Günter Eich structured his radio version of this story as an autobiographically conceived frame story by Dschaudar's mother, which then includes two interrelated stories.

title: Eine Bank und drei Stühle, eine Gestalt in Schwarz mit gelbem Hut und im Vordergrund eine schwarze Katze. Der Himmel blassgrün.
author: Klangmanufaktur
description: The correspondence between the painter Vincent van Gogh (1853-1890) and his brother Theo (1857-1890) lasted a total of 18 years. Vincent opened himself up to no other person as unreservedly as his brother, who worked as an art dealer, without whose help surviving as a painter would not have been possible.

title: Pleiten, Pech und Pflaumbaum (1. Teil: Das Dübelübel)
author: Herbert Friedmann
description: Marco Pflaumbaum is only twelve years old, but he is already starting to write his memoirs as a precaution. Marco's life is always eventful, and that's not least thanks to his father, mother and Grandpa Pflaumbaum, who all have a knack for disaster.

title: Pleiten, Pech und Pflaumbaum (2. Teil: Der Wortschatzsucher)
author: Herbert Friedmann
description: Marco Pflaumbaum is only twelve years old, but he is already starting to write his memoirs as a precaution. Marco's life is always eventful, and that's not least thanks to his father, mother and Grandpa Pflaumbaum, who all have a knack for disaster.

title: Pleiten, Pech und Pflaumbaum (3. Teil: Der geheime Hund)
author: Herbert Friedmann
description: Marco Pflaumbaum is only twelve years old, but he is already starting to write his memoirs as a precaution. Marco's life is always eventful, and that's not least thanks to his father, mother and Grandpa Pflaumbaum, who all have a knack for disaster.

title: Pleiten, Pech und Pflaumbaum (5. Teil: Das chinesische Weihnachtsfest)
author: Herbert Friedmann
description: Marco Pflaumbaum is only twelve years old, but he is already starting to write his memoirs as a precaution. Marco's life is always eventful, and that's not least thanks to his father, mother and Grandpa Pflaumbaum, who all have a knack for disaster.

title: "Es geht nicht darum, sich kennenzulernen, sondern sein Leben zu ändern."
author: Walter van Rossum
description: Shortly after the Second World War, the writer and philosopher Jean-Paul Sartre entered the public stage. Without regard to the ceremonies of the spirit, he transformed the word and thought into a military force in a way that had not happened since the Enlightenment - and especially not after Sartre.

title: Tagebuch eines Landlebens oder Kein Mord in der Leiblstraße
protagonist_verified: a writer on the Bavarian countryside
author: Sebastian Goy
description: The Bavarian picture book of a writer who loves Edgar Allan Poe and Jean Paul. So with features of a crime story, but also with diary notes, with love, poetry, powerlessness, disguise, politics.

title: Chemie der Erinnerungen
author: Horst Zahlten
description: With his first successes in the areas of memory transfer and memory deletion, Prof. Hegewald set himself the goal of freeing mentally ill people from the triggers of their psychoses through partial memory deletion.

title: Bellas Briefe
author: Hans Zimmer
description: Since her parents divorced, she has had everything twice, once with mom and once with dad. Except her doll Bella, who is almost as old as she is and is unique. But yesterday Klara forgot her doll on the bench in the park.

title: Böses Spielzeug. Meira Ashers Warnungen vor der Realität
author: Hartwig Vens
description: The musician and performance artist Meira Asher comes from Israel, but has been living in The Hague for several years, where she works at the Institute for Sonology. In her projects she has taken up topics such as the Holocaust, the Israel-Palestine conflict and most recently the phenomenon of child soldiers.

title: Briefe an Georges
protagonist_verified: Elias Canetti, Veza Canetti, and Georges Canetti
author: Elias Canetti; Canetti Veza
description: In addition to his wife Veza, whom he married out of friendship, Elias Canetti constantly has mistresses. The unhappy Veza opens her heart to the youngest Canetti, her brother-in-law Georges.

title: Aus den Briefen von Paul Cézanne und Emile Bernard sowie aus den Briefen von Rainer Maria Rilke und Clara Westhoff
protagonist_verified: Paul Cézanne, Emile Bernard, Rainer Maria Rilke, and Clara Westhoff
author: Paul Cézanne; Emile Bernard; Rainer Maria Rilke; Clara Westhoff
description: A radio work based on Correspondence between Cézanne and Bernard (letters, French), Correspondence between Rilke and Westhoff (letters).

title: Rot ist mein Name (2. Teil: Das Porträt)
author: Orhan Pamuk
description: The body of the gilder Fein Effendi lies dead at the bottom of a well, waiting to finally be found. Kara, who has returned to Istanbul after a twelve-year absence, is commissioned by his uncle to investigate Fein Effendi's disappearance.

title: Robert Schell - Porträt eines Arbeiters (2. Teil)
author: Max Stoll; Dieter Langhut
description: Broadcast as part of the 11th week of children's and youth radio work in 1969.

title: Ein Tagebuch wird verbrannt
author: Maria Seidemann
description: Seventeen-year-old Rosa Luxemburg, a member of the Communist Party headquarters, is ordered to secretly leave the country within a few hours in order to avoid the threat of arrest.

title: Robert Schell - Porträt eines Arbeiters(3)
author: Max Stoll; Dieter Langhut
description: Broadcast as part of the 11th week of children's and youth radio work in 1969.

title: Robert Schell - Porträt eines Arbeiters (1. Teil)
author: Max Stoll; Dieter Langhut
description: Broadcast as part of the 11th week of children's and youth radio work in 1969.

title: Robert Schell - Porträt eines Arbeiters (4. Teil)
author: Max Stoll; Dieter Langhut
description: Broadcast as part of the 11th week of children's and youth radio work in 1969.

title: Tagebuchblätter aus Hanoi: Aus dem Tagebuch der stellvertretenden Oberkommandierenden der Befreiungsarmee Südvietnams - Gujen Ti Din - einer bekannten Heerführerin des vietnamesischen Volkes
author: Nguyen Thin Dinh
description: Produced and broadcast on the occasion of the II International Festival of Children's and Youth radio works in 1969.

title: Ohne Datum
protagonist_verified: An unnamed man in his thirties
author: Karl Günther Hufnagel
description: A man in his thirties has a tumor in his lung; He knows that he only has a short time left to live: agonizing waiting, inner rebellion, apparent submission.

title: Robert Schell - Porträt eines Arbeiters (5. Teil)
author: Max Stoll; Dieter Langhut
description: Broadcast as part of the 11th week of children's and youth radio work in 1969.

title: Tagebuchblätter aus Hanoi: Aus dem Tagebuch der jungen Lehrerin Pe Ha aus einem Rajong in Südvietnam, aufgeschrieben am 19. März 1961 - dem 11. Jahrestag der antiamerikanischen Demonstration in Saigon
protagonist_verified: Pe Ha, a young teacher in South Vietnam
author: Giang Nam
description: Produced and broadcast on the occasion of the II International Festival of Children's and Youth radio works in 1969.

title: Liebe Claudia
author: Bodo Schulenburg
description: Heiz Hoffmann's life path is the path of a working-class boy to becoming a general! To a general who leads the army of the victorious German working class. It is the path of a communist who has dedicated his entire life to building a peace-loving socialist society.

title: Heart Beat
author: Carolyn Cassady
description: She actually wanted a completely normal family life. With husband, children, house and garden. But she had married Neal Cassady, the beatnik and womanizer, the friend of Kerouac and Ginsberg.

title: Erinnerungen einer Sängerin am Klavier
author: Jenny Lind
description: Jenny Lind, the "Swedish Nightingale" (1820-1887), is considered the leading coloratura singer of her time. Their performances had characteristics of today's rock concert hysteria: when they sang, women fainted and men lost their senses and had to be carried out of the opera houses.

title: Ich lese in Jasnas Tagebuch
author: Mirjana Buljan
description: Ana reads the diary of her 15-year-old daughter Jasna and, in dialogue with her second self, examines her behavior and parenting methods towards her daughter.

title: Tagebuch einer Freundschaft
author: Ovidiu Zotta
description: Andrej has a complicated temperament that easily goes to extremes. On the one hand he would like to be one of the biggest rowdies, but on the other hand he would also like to be one of the best students in the class.

title: Polar
author: Albert Ostermaier
description: There are moments and gestures that aim to last forever. Essential things crystallize in them. Her preferred stage is the cinema. And sometimes entire films thrive on these stylizations.

title: Das Tagebuch des verschütteten Bergmanns Martino Tiff
author: Pietro Formentini
description: A great metaphor is created: Martino Tiff, a simple tunnel worker in a mine in the Federal Republic of Germany, is buried and trapped during a mining accident, and the listener will gradually understand over the course of the piece that Tiff actually had to live in the inhumane isolation of class society throughout his life.

title: 600 Briefe von meinem Vermieter
protagonist_verified: An unnamed tenant and his landlord
author: Christoph Spittler
description: My landlord writes me letters. Since I've lived in my apartment, twelve years. The letter is always in my box on time on Thursday. In each of these letters, my landlord lists all my offenses like a litany.

title: Des Eisenhans Erinnerungen oder Paraphrase über ein deutsches Thema
author: Günter Kunert
description: Günter Kunert's variation on the Grimm fairy tale "Eisenhans" could be called a "Scherzo more Germanico". What remains of the original fairy tale is the figure of Iron Hans - here a kind of forest rascal, fairy tale robot or ancient Pan, Germanic Poseidon - a quite grotesque German figure.

title: Scherzo more germanico
author: Dieter Hasselblatt
description: Before beginning Kunert's radio story, Dieter Hasselblatt reports how the "Eisenhans Variations" series came about and what thoughts and goals dominated him when awarding the radio contracts.

title: Alles ist Gnade: Monologe nach dem Tagebuch eines Landpfarrers (3. Teil: 3. Monolog)
author: Georges Bernanos
description: A radio work based on Diary of a country priest (Journal d'un Curé de Campagne) (novel, French) text adaptation: Leo Waltermann.

title: Alles ist Gnade: Monologe nach dem Tagebuch eines Landpfarrers (4. Teil: 4. Monolog)
author: Georges Bernanos
description: A radio work based on Diary of a country priest (Journal d'un Curé de Campagne) (novel, French) text adaptation: Leo Waltermann.

title: Doktor Faustus (1. Teil)
broadcasting_station: Hessischer Rundfunk / Bayerischer Rundfunk / in Kooperation mit der IEMA (Internationale Ensemble Modern Akademie)
author: Thomas Mann
description: Adaptation of Thomas Mann's fictional biography Doctor Faustus, whose protagonist is the fictional composer Adrian Leverkühn. The radio version realizes the novel as a ten-part production.

title: Briefe an Mathilda
author: Leszek Prorok
description: With this radio work the author continues the tradition of Polish social comedy.

title: Doktor Faustus (4. Teil)
broadcasting_station: Hessischer Rundfunk / Bayerischer Rundfunk / in Kooperation mit der IEMA (Internationale Ensemble Modern Akademie)
author: Thomas Mann
description: Adaptation of Thomas Mann's fictional biography Doctor Faustus, centered on the fictional composer Adrian Leverkühn and Mann's modern devil-pact Künstlerroman.

title: Doktor Faustus (8. Teil)
broadcasting_station: Hessischer Rundfunk / Bayerischer Rundfunk / in Kooperation mit der IEMA (Internationale Ensemble Modern Akademie)
author: Thomas Mann
description: Adaptation of Thomas Mann's fictional biography Doctor Faustus. Its protagonist is the fictional composer Adrian Leverkühn, whose invented life draws on Mann's biography and Friedrich Nietzsche.

title: Briefe und Hiebe
author: Hansgeorg Meyer
description: Jan's rustic parenting methods trigger a sharp epistolary polemic with Jeannette, in which they both hide their affection for each other behind technical talk. Uwe and Heiko stop the polemic from escalating by cunningly bringing about a reunion between Jan, Jeannette and the group.

title: Porträt eines Helden
author: Arne Leonhardt
description: Father Neumann agrees to portray the BGL chairman, Wilfried Ohme, whom he has "known very well" and with whom he has worked closely for years, in an article for the company newspaper on the occasion of the FDGB's 30th anniversary, and suddenly has to realize how difficult it is to create a vivid picture of a person...

title: The Glenn Gould Trilogy
author: Michael Stegemann
description: Radio As Music: The Canadian Glenn Gould (1932-1982) was not only "the greatest pianist of all time", which Thomas Bernhard described him as in his novel "The Untergeher", but also a visionary radio and media pioneer.

title: Weil irgendetwas das so will
author: Robert Schoen
description: Anyone who writes a diary does not know the end of the story, does not know which of the writing posts driven into the rushing time will remain.

title: Das Monster in uns
author: Anette Kührmeyer
description: Marion Aubert, the author of the SR/DKultur production "DieStörenfriede", provides information about how she works, whether she laughs while doing it, which literature has influenced her, why the adults in her plays often behave like children - and vice versa - and why she always writes about "the monster in us" in each piece.

title: Es wird Fragen geben - Ein west-östliches Tagebuch
author: Florian Goldberg; Heike Tauch
description: Hanna from East Berlin and Peter from Cologne learn that they have a half-sibling in the other part of Germany following a German-German love affair between Peter's father and Hanna's mother.

title: Longkamp
author: Rolf Dieter Brinkmann
description: Letters, notes, maps that create a monologue - about the question of "how someone gets out of this today." When Rolf Dieter Brinkmann moved to Longkamp, ​​a village in the Hunsrück, for a few weeks at the end of November 1972, his escape from the noise of the city was at the same time a farewell to his belief in rebellion, pop and the underground.

title: Ortiz destructs
author: Justin Hoffmann
description: Raphael Montanez Ortiz, born in Brooklyn, New York City in 1934, is a painter, performer, video artist and actionist and one of the main initiators of destruction art in the early 1960s.

title: Pariser Abende
author: Roland Barthes
description: Roland Barthes wrote "Soirées de Paris" over a period of about three weeks, between August 24th and September 17th, 1979. In a note, Barthes also called this text "The Vain Evenings".

title: Am Anfang war der Blick
author: Guido Gin Koster
description: The focus of the radio work is the war photographer Mathilda: a portrait of her restless life after her death.

title: NOA NOA
author: Paul Gauguin
description: For the journey to Gauguin's hut, Titi "put on her most beautiful dress, a flower behind her ear, her raffia hat decorated with a garnish of orange shells and her long black hair hanging loosely over her shoulders.

title: Im Übergangskleid fehlen die gelben Achselhaare
author: Frank Kaspar
description: He made bat calls audible on a record, fought for the copyright of starlings that imitated sound poems by Kurt Schwitters and brought eleven extinct bird species back to life in his radio work "Séance Vocibus Avium" (BR 2008): For the piece in which colleagues such as Annette Humpe, Namosh and Françoise Cactus...

title: Die Gardine, die Landschaft, das Fenster und der Klangraum
author: Stephan Krass
description: When looking at a curtain, says Oswald Egger, you can choose how you focus your gaze: on the network of transparent fabric or on the landscape behind it. Things get interesting when you change the focus.

title: KLAUS KINSKI
author: Michael Farin; Peter Geyer
description: Klaus Kinski has embodied myths throughout his life, including Marquis de Sade, Edgar Allan Poe, Jack the Ripper, Nosferatu, Woyzeck and Aguirre, the "Wrath of God". But when he died 20 years ago, on November 23, 1991, he had long since become a myth himself.

title: Feldpost - Briefe deutscher Soldaten aus Afghanistan
author: N. N.
description: German soldiers have been fighting a grueling war in Afghanistan for almost ten years. And to this day, politicians and the leadership of the Bundeswehr have not understood how to explain to the people of Germany why.

title: Der Berater
author: György Dalos; Andrea Dunai
description: Accompanies Mikhail Gorbachev and his family on vacation to the Crimean peninsula. While the president looks confidently into the future, C. suspects that shortly before the return trip to Moscow, a delegation of putschists wants to force the president to resign.

title: Buntschatten und Fledermäuse
author: Axel Brauns
description: When Axel was two years old, the world retreated from him. The people around him suddenly had hooded faces. He heard her words, but didn't understand the meaning - and certainly not the emotional nuances.

title: Hörspielraum: Das fünfte Element
author: Sylvia Rauer
description: With her “radio work Space” projects, Sylvia Rauer has been accompanying special radio work productions for years. This time she follows Susanne Amatosero into a sound-music intermediate world that bridges the gap between banality and the magic of everyday life.

title: Alexander Kluge
author: Karl Bruckmaier
description: He is stingy with his ego – Alexander Kluge, born in 1932 in Halberstadt. Winner of almost all important film and literary awards. His self usually steps behind or next to the camera, turns to a topic or a guest, and asks questions.

title: Tolstois Befreiung
author: Ivan Bunin
description: Ivan Bunin (1870-1953), who was the first Russian to win the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1933, worshiped Leo Tolstoy and called him his "god." In 1937, while in exile in Paris, he published a controversial, very personal homage to the great writer: "Tolstoy's Liberation.".

title: Ich muss auf einen Sprung weg
author: Jean-Claude Kuner
description: Walter Spies (1895-1942), painter and musician, a universally interested, early "dropout". He stays in artistic circles in Dresden and Berlin, is friends with, among others, Oskar Kokoschka and Hans Jürgen von Wense, and lives with the film director Friedrich W.

title: Tristram Shandy
author: Laurence Sterne
description: Contrary to the title's announcement, which suggests a fictional autobiography, the reader learns little about the life of the title hero and first-person narrator Tristram.

title: Herr Molander schreibt seine Memoiren (5. Teil: Die hellblauen Briefe)
author: Werner E. Hintz
description: Mr. Molander writes his memoirs (Part 5: The Light Blue Letters).

title: Wind und englisches Eichenholz
author: Alfred Andersch
description: Conversations and memories in Dover.

title: Es war einmal
author: Unbekannt
description: Biography of a street.

title: Der Landstörzerin Courasche abenteurlich Leben
author: Hans Jakob Christoffel von Grimmelshausen
description: The "Trutz Simplex" is also a fictional autobiography of a satirical-simplician character, which, like the "Simplicissimus", essentially takes place against the backdrop of the Thirty Years' War, sketched according to historical sources.

title: Herzog zu vermieten
author: Mischa Mleinek
description: Duke Archibald of Tipperary, an abdicated heir to the throne, and Duchess Elsa live abroad, have no money and are fighting hard to keep their names high.

protagonist_verified: Maarten, a 30-year-old man in a pietistic Dutch village
author: Maarten’t Hart
description: Maarten 't Hart's radio work A Flock of Whimbrels is an adaptation of his autobiographical novel of the same name from 1978 - and yet much more: This radio work about the barren and lonely life in a pietistic village in the Dutch provinces impresses with its acoustic narrative style.

title: Monument für eine Stimme
author: Lou Brouwers
description: The Russian author Nadezhda Mandelstam saved many of her late husband Ossip Mandelstam's poems from oblivion and confiscation in a unique way: she learned them by heart.

title: Ein Held unserer Zeit
author: Michail Lermontov
description: With the character of Officer Pechorin, Mikhail Lermontov created one of the first dandies in world literature. "A Hero of Our Time" tells stories from the life of this "superfluous" person who plays with other people's lives and feelings.

title: plus null komma fünf windstill
protagonist_verified: young woman tracing her family history
author: Maria Kilpi
description: Drama • The Finnish-Russian border divides Karelia, the region is characterized by conflict and displacement. A young woman wants to trace her family history and comes across ice walls.

title: Sasha Marianna Salzmann stört das Schema
author: Jenny Marrenbach
director: die Autorin Es sprach: Peggy Bachmann Technische Realisation: Michael Kube Redaktion: Tina Klopp
description: Sasha Marianna Salzmann is a shooting star not only in the literary world, but also in the theater: the stage and book pages become an experiment with identity, including her own.

title: Der Legendenseher
author: Guthmann, Daniel
description: In his films he brings Armenian, Georgian, Ukrainian and Azerbaijani legends to new life. The Soviet cultural bureaucracy harassed him for this.

title: Maestro der Comebacks
author: Jean-Claude Kuner
description: Portrait of the Brazilian pianist and conductor João Carlos Martins, who is one of the great, unfairly forgotten Bach interpreters of the 20th century. A life story as unusual as his music.

title: Es brummt
author: Beate Mayer
description: The mysterious low tone, which only a few people can hear, is a mystery - neither the source nor the cause are yet known. The author Beate Mayer went in search of the humming sound.

title: Der Fall Padura
author: Peter B. Schumann
description: A famous author whose work is hushed up by the media in his own country. Leonardo Padura has revived the Cuban crime novel genre. Between international success and ostracism, Padura leads an eventful life.

title: Weidwerk
author: Rilo Chmielorz
director: die Autorin Es sprachen: Eva Brunner und Robert Meller
description: The happy hormones come when you shoot. When they are eviscerated they become even stronger. At the age of 55 she got her hunting license. To understand yourself as part of nature.

title: Vom Glück der Abwechslung
author: Nora Bauer
description: The composer Sven-Ingo Koch about the challenges and joys of working with radio works.

title: Kevin
author: Massimo Maio
description: How do children and young people grow up on the outskirts of the city?

title: Die Pionierin der Sexualwissenschaft, Charlotte Wolff, bittet um die Hand
author: Ursula Krechel
description: In 1979, an 82-year-old emigrant from England traveled to the Women's University in Berlin. A doctor who worked in maternity care in the 1920s and was friends with Walter Benjamin and Franz Hessel.

title: Sprachmusik
author: Nora Bauer
description: For Dietrich Petzold, the sound of the words is particularly important in his radio work compositions; this 'speech music' inspires him to create instrumental compositions. Nora Bauer about the sound artist who uses his invented instruments to create sounds that make objects or events audible.

title: Neues aus der Welt der Akustischen Kunst
author: Küchler, Sabine
description: We portray the radio work musician Dietrich Petzold, continue our history of radio work dramaturgy and take a look at interesting new productions in April.

title: Der türkische Komponist Emre Dündar
author: Franziska Buhre
description: As a performer, the Turkish composer Emre Dündar deals primarily with language, creating poems written from sounds, recited poetry, stories or singing.

title: Hörspielmagazin 09/20: Portrait Martin Schütz (Podcast)
author: Bauer, Nora
description: Classics of literature, exciting dramas, entertaining stories and innovative sound art. There are great stories, strong voices and fine sounds here - radio works from Deutschlandfunk and Deutschlandfunk Kultur.

title: Hörspielmagazin 08/20: Portrait Hardy Kurda (Podcast)
author: Klatte, Tina
description: Classics of literature, exciting dramas, entertaining stories and innovative sound art. There are great stories, strong voices and fine sounds here - radio works from Deutschlandfunk and Deutschlandfunk Kultur.

title: Hörspielmagazin 07/20: Portrait AnniKa von Trier (Podcast)
author: Bauer, Nora
description: Classics of literature, exciting dramas, entertaining stories and innovative sound art. There are great stories, strong voices and fine sounds here - radio works from Deutschlandfunk and Deutschlandfunk Kultur.

title: Hörspielmagazin 06/ 20 - Portrait Volkan T(Podcast)
author: Murrenhoff, Sarah
description: Classics of literature, exciting dramas, entertaining stories and innovative sound art. There are great stories, strong voices and fine sounds here - radio works from Deutschlandfunk and Deutschlandfunk Kultur.

title: Ausgrabung einer Utopie
author: Rosa Hannah Ziegler
description: In May 1980, the utopia became reality for a few days: the anti-nuclear movement proclaimed the Free Republic of Wendland. Today, archaeologists are digging for remnants of this primal moment of the alternative scene into which the author was born.

title: Im Schatten des amerikanischen Traums
author: Jean-Claude Kuner
description: New York artist David Wojnarowicz has never had so much attention. In the 1980s he was part of the New York underground. Today his radical, political art is more in demand than ever, and not just in the USA.

title: Jane Eyre (1/3)
broadcasting_station: Saarländischer Rundfunk / Deutschlandradio Kultur / Norddeutscher Rundfunk / Radio Bremen
author: dem gleichnamigen Roman von Charlotte Brontë
description: Jane Eyre (1/3) - radio work based on Charlotte Brontë • Classic • A novel about female self-determination: It tells the life story of a woman in the 19th century who fights for her freedom and autonomy - successfully despite much resistance.

title: Albatros
author: Mario Willms
description: Love story • Robert, without a permanent home but with a positive attitude towards life, moves through Berlin at night and tells his life story: of involuntary fame, of the ethos of the homeless, of love and other afflictions.

title: BRUDER. Eine deutsch-litauische Geschwistergeschichte
author: Jurate Braginaite
description: For both of them it took them from Lithuania to Germany, for him back and forth to prison. Their lives were different: at 36, he saw the inside of more prison cells than he could count.

title: Wolfgang – Ein Leben auf 20.000 Kassetten
author: Christian Collet
description: After the death of Berlin bank employee Wolfgang Seelbinder, radio archivist Christian Collet came across his life story - recorded on 20,000 cassettes.

title: Amerika der Träume
author: Thomas David
description: Shortly before Auster's 75th birthday on February 3rd, feature writer Thomas David visited the writer in New York and spoke to him about his “America of dreams.”.

title: Generation U
protagonist_verified: Ukrainian children and teenagers in Germany
author: Inga Lizengevic
director: die Autorin Es sprachen: Zeynep Bozbay, Lisa Hrdina, Timo Weisschnur und die Autorin
description: 350,000 children have also fled Ukraine to Germany since 2022. After three and a half years, many are wondering where their future lies. Some long for home despite the war.

title: Erzählen, wie es weitergeht
author: Jürgen Becker
description: Literature • Who are we when we are alone? How do our memories guide our consciousness? The radio work by Büchner Prize winner Jürgen Becker sharpens our awareness of processes of experience.

title: Heimgesucht
author: Silas Degen
description: In the Johannaberg children's health home near Detmold, children who were deported had to experience homesickness, fear and violence. Decades later, a group of contemporary witnesses set out on a journey.

title: doku drops 6: Old Tapes
protagonist_verified: old tape recordings and half-forgotten voices
author: Zusammenstellung und Moderation: Judith Geffert und Ingo Kottkamp
description: They lie dormant in attics, in drawers and on old hard drives: recordings that haven't been listened to for a long time. In our short documentaries, the dust is wiped off the cassette cover and half-forgotten voices come to life again.

title: Der Afrik
author: dem gleichnamigen Roman von Sven Recker
description: From the Black Forest to Algeria and back. An exiled outsider wants to take revenge on his home village, the wine village of Pfaffenweiler in Baden, which lured him to Algeria with false promises.

title: Warum vergessen wir Dinge?
author: Braun, Babette
description: There are reasons why we can't remember everything and forgetting can sometimes even be really useful.

title: Schwebende Brücken
author: Maike Wetzel
description: The radio work “Floating Bridges” was chosen as the radio work of the month for June 2025 by the Academy of Performing Arts.

title: Damenabteilung
author: Manuel Gogos und Christoph Spittler
director: Philippe Brühl Redaktion: Barbara Schäfer und Lisa Steck Deutschlandfunk 2025 Zu Teil 1 der Serie Konsum und Konkurs
description: The authors get lost in the women's section. In Troisdorf near Cologne, 150 former Hertie saleswomen are meeting for a revival. The branch closed 40 years ago.

title: Alleestraße
protagonist_verified: growing up in the Ruhr area in the 1960s and 1970s
author: Hörspiel von Roland E. Koch
description: Growing up in the Ruhr area in the 60s and 70s: cramped conditions, the speechlessness of a middle-class nuclear family, the violence in the internally damaged post-war society.

title: Rückkehr der Zauberflöte
author: Mario Bandi
director: der Autor Es sprachen: Katherina Wolter und der Autor
description: Anne-Katrin Probst was born in Ulan Bator. Her parents returned to the GDR from their relief mission for socialist Mongolia when she was two years old. It is full of images, sounds, stories from a magical land, beautiful and terrible at the same time.

title: Also muss ich überleben!
author: Manfred Bonson
director: Matthias Kapohl Es sprachen: Picco von Groote, Nikolaus Benda, Judith Jakob, Jochen Langner und Claudia Mischke
description: She doesn't just want to watch: When war breaks out, Savita Wagner goes to Ukraine to help. As a medic at the front, she saves many wounded people. Until she is fatally hit by shrapnel.

title: Wer war Anne Frank?
author: Voss, Regina
description: Anne Frank became world famous primarily because of her diary, which she kept in the secret annex in Amsterdam. But Anne also wrote stories.

title: HERZBEFELLT, ein Nachrufen
author: Frieda Paris
description: Poetry • The young author Frieda Paris writes an obituary for the famous Friederike Mayröcker. About an intimate creative process and a poetic discussion.

title: Die vier Söhne des Dr. March
author: Brigitte Aubert
description: The housemaid Jeanie comes across the diary of a sex offender. The murderer is one of her employer's four sons. In the middle of her research, she finds herself caught up in a sadistic hunt.

title: Schießbuden haben noch immer einen Reiz für mich
author: Hörstück mit unveröffentlichten Texten von Ré Soupault von Andra Joeckle
description: The artist Ré Soupault cycles through a post-war Germany in ruins. Like the country, Ré is also on the move. Andra Joeckle stages the German-French artist's logbook, and we pedal along.

title: Zwischen allen Stühlen (3/3)
broadcasting_station: DeutschlandRadio Berlin / Sender Freies Berlin-Ostdeutscher Rundfunk Brandenburg
author: Victor Klemperer
description: Contemporary document • The last chapter of a bourgeois humanist's life: Victor Klemperer keeps a constant diary, writing about personal tragedies and his everyday life in the GDR.

title: Zwischen allen Stühlen (2/3)
broadcasting_station: DeutschlandRadio Berlin / Sender Freies Berlin-Ostdeutscher Rundfunk Brandenburg
author: Victor Klemperer
description: Contemporary document • "I have been disrespected more than a dog. They are now trying to get me by all means possible. What will happen tomorrow?" The philologist Victor Klemperer records his life in the young GDR.

title: Zeugnis ablegen (2/6)
author: Victor Klemperer
description: Contemporary document • "I have the impression that an explosion is imminent. I expect pogroms, ghetto, money and house confiscation. Rather: I expect nothing." Klemperer meticulously documents his everyday life under National Socialism.

title: Flog ein Vogel federlos
author: Christine Nagel
description: Literature • A small town in the mid-80s. A perfect family in their little world. Chernobyl, rearmament and environmental destruction have no place there. Then the daughter disappears into herself.

title: Tagebuch 1985–1989
author: Sándor Márai
description: Literary document • The diaries of the writer Sándor Márai are the record of a great love and at the same time a merciless reflection on the last things: loneliness, illness, death.

title: Meine liebe Änne!
author: Ricarda Bethke
description: Autobiography • Only after her mother's death did Ricarda Bethke find out about her forced sterilization in 1942. Using letters and documents, the author traces a life that maintains silence after the injustice she suffered.

title: Erinnern und verklären
author: Almut Schnerring und Sascha Verlan
director: die Autoren Es sprachen: Janina Sachau, Sigrid Burkholder, Isis Krüger, Matthias Haase und Martin Bross
description: "Every great time requires great and tough people, great in ability, character and faith. We want to educate you for this..." (for Hans-Martin, 1939). - record the thoughts and feelings that come to them after the arrival of their child, form a memory book, a guide for the adolescents.

title: Natur an Autorin - Autorin an Natur
author: Elke Heinemann
director: Martin Zylka Redaktion Dlf: Klaus Pilger
description: Nature writing is more than nature poetry. It is the literary response to the age of the Anthropocene. Author Elke Heinemann succeeds in a self-experiment in the tradition of Henry David Thoreau's “Walden”.

title: Zeitenwende
protagonist_verified: East and West German residents of a senior home
author: Heike Tauch
description: West and East biographies meet in a facility for seniors. A place of expected stories? What people tell about their lives is much richer and more complex.

title: Schubladen
protagonist_verified: six women from East and West Germany
author: She She Pop
description: Biographies • Six women – three who grew up in the East, three in the West of Germany – open their drawers. By showing and comparing letters, diaries, photos and sounds, they want to get to know each other better.

title: Kein König in Israel
author: Maxim Biller
description: Maxim Biller's documentary fiction about Jewish identity, the writer Jossl Brenner, who was murdered more than 100 years ago, and the anti-Jewish pogroms in Palestine in 1921.

title: Hauptsache Hörspiel - Folge 25
author: Steger, Hanna/ Malotki, Max von
description: When two clever writers write letters to each other for years, it's relatively logical that it can turn into a very entertaining book.

title: Briefe an mich
author: Esther Schelander
director: die Autorin Es sprach die Autorin
description: “What shaped my sexuality?” The author asks herself this based on letters that she has written to herself since her youth. She looks for answers in the pop culture relics of the nineties, in BRAVO magazines, Hollywood films and pop songs.

title: Der Schatten des Meisters (2/2)
author: dem Roman "Der rote Domino" von Marc Buhl
description: Literary expert Udo Stahl follows the trail of the missing student Bettina B. Secret letters between Goethe and Lenz were stolen from an archive here. What does the missing doctoral student know about stolen art?

title: Strafkolonie der Frauen
author: Lizengevic, Inga
description: Contact with the outside world is hardly possible. If relatives pass on information, they and the inmates are threatened with reprisals. Lukashenko's regime is making political prisoners disappear.

title: Korallenpilz
author: Podcastserie von Felizitas Stilleke und Conrad Rodenberg
description: Felizitas and Conrad's fathers were also absent during their lifetime and before the illness. But where were they all this time when they weren't with their children?

title: Gibt es den Weihnachtsmann wirklich?
author: Mit Patricia und Merle
description: Even if you can't always really see him, all children know that he exists. But how do you actually recognize the real Santa Claus?

title: Ernst Ludwig Kirchner – Inside Out
author: Elke Heinemann
description: Experimental documentary fiction • The audio picture collages excerpts from Ernst Ludwig Kirchner's diaries and sketchbooks with witness statements and letters to his friend, doctor and collector Dr. farmer.

title: Lisa, der Nerd und die Unsichtbaren
author: Esther Schelander
description: “Programming first had to be made male,” writes computer historian Nathan Ensmeger. Because in the beginning, programming was a woman's job.

title: Leben ist Leben – Tod ist Tod
author: Martina Groß
description: How can the work of Richard O. Moore be described? What characterizes his poetic legacy? And what did he experience as a contemporary witness to the literary movement of the San Francisco Renaissance in the 1940s? A feature about the life’s work of the poet, who died in 2015.

title: Aufräumen oder Der Abschied von der Dissidenz
author: Lutz Rathenow
description: Classics of literature, exciting dramas, entertaining stories and innovative sound art. There are great stories, strong voices and fine sounds here - radio works from Deutschlandfunk and Deutschlandfunk Kultur.
